_doc: Pessoas no 4.0, relógio 16:00: quem espera na guia e a multidão longe, pares das fotos 36 e 37.

steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__roadcraft; const L = [...r.sim.pedViews.values ? r.sim.pedViews.values() : r.sim.pedViews]; const p = (L.find((p) => p.kerbWait || (!p.walking && p.ground === 'footway'))); if (!p) return 'nenhum espera'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 70, azimuth: p.heading + 2.2, elevation: 9 * Math.PI / 180 }); return JSON.stringify({ n: 'espera', g: p.ground, wait: p.kerbWait, v: p.v, walking: p.walking }); })()

(() => { const r = window.__roadcraft; const L = [...r.sim.pedViews.values ? r.sim.pedViews.values() : r.sim.pedViews]; const p = (L.find((p) => p.ground === 'footway')); if (!p) return 'nenhum multidao'; r.setView({ x: p.x, y: p.y, zoom: 9, azimuth: p.heading + 2.2, elevation: 4 * Math.PI / 180 }); return JSON.stringify({ n: 'multidao', g: p.ground, wait: p.kerbWait, v: p.v, walking: p.walking }); })()
